sources.games: 370 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 50.0%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py slark.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Bloodthorn, Butterfly, Black King Bar.

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. Shadow Blade is in his build (35%, ~23 min): against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar finish it into Silver Edge, 36% of 44 games against them (12% otherwise), won 75% against 50%.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 86% (4), power_treads 100% (6), diffusal_blade 85% (12), pers 40% (14), mage_slayer 36% (16), echo_sabre 20% (16), ultimate_scepter 74% (21), great_famango 22% (22), invis_sword 35% (23), aghanims_shard 58% (28), silver_edge 21% (28), black_king_bar 35% (29), skadi 25% (35), disperser 34% (36).

skills.basis: 370 games: maxed slark_dark_pact > slark_pounce > slark_saltwater_shiv 311 (win 50.5%), slark_dark_pact > slark_pounce 27 (win 29.6%), slark_dark_pact > slark_saltwater_shiv > slark_pounce 17 (win 58.8%); talents 10: Pounce Leash 206/368 (54.9%), Dark Pact Cooldown 162/368 (44.4%); 15: Dark Pact Damage 264/346 (50.0%), Shadow Dance Regen 82/346 (62.2%); 20: Shadow Dance Attack Speed 168/192 (60.1%), Agility gain/stolen per Essence Shift Stack 24/192 (66.7%); 25: Essence Shift Duration 58/96 (70.7%), Shadow Dance Duration 38/96 (63.2%).

suppress.illusions: Diffusal Blade and Disperser are in his build and high-rank Slarks do not buy Maelstrom against illusion heroes (Disperser 28% of games against them, 22% otherwise).
